gloss: oh (showing understanding); oh? (showing doubt)

sentence.zh: 哦，原来你早就知道这件事了。
sentence.en: Oh, so you knew about this long ago.

gloss: noun suffix used after some nouns (as in stone, wood, tongue)

sentence.zh: 院子里有一块大石头，孩子们喜欢坐在上面玩。
sentence.en: There's a big stone in the yard, and the kids like to sit on it and play.

gloss: like, as; if

sentence.zh: 如有任何疑问，请随时与我们联系。
sentence.en: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

gloss: same, alike; together; with, and

sentence.zh: 他和我同岁，可是看起来比我大好几岁。
sentence.en: He and I are the same age, but he looks several years older than me.

gloss: such, so, like this

sentence.zh: 没想到这次考试竟然如此简单，大家都很快交了卷。
sentence.en: Nobody expected the exam to be so easy; everyone handed in their papers quickly.

gloss: to get along with, to handle; place, location

sentence.zh: 他脾气好，跟邻居们一直处得很好。
sentence.en: He's good-natured and has always got along well with his neighbours.

gloss: his, her, its, their; that

sentence.zh: 这家公司的产品质量好，其价格也比较合理。
sentence.en: This company's products are of good quality, and their prices are also fairly reasonable.

gloss: once, ever (in the past)

sentence.zh: 我曾在北京工作过三年，对那里很熟悉。
sentence.en: I once worked in Beijing for three years, so I know it well.

gloss: side, aspect; surface

sentence.zh: 解决这个问题，我们要考虑经济和环境两个方面。
sentence.en: To solve this problem, we need to consider both the economic and environmental aspects.

gloss: to depend on; to lean against; to be near

sentence.zh: 他完全靠自己的努力考上了大学。
sentence.en: He got into university entirely through his own hard work.

gloss: scene (of an event); site; on the spot; live

sentence.zh: 演唱会现场来了好几万名观众。
sentence.en: Tens of thousands of spectators came to the concert venue.

gloss: to exceed, to surpass, to go over

sentence.zh: 这条路限速六十公里，他开到了九十，严重超速了。
sentence.en: The speed limit on this road is 60 km/h; he was doing 90, seriously speeding.

gloss: and, as well as

sentence.zh: 会议讨论了教育、医疗及住房等问题。
sentence.en: The meeting discussed issues such as education, healthcare and housing.

gloss: to have; to possess; to own

sentence.zh: 他拥有一家很受欢迎的咖啡店。
sentence.en: He owns a very popular coffee shop.

gloss: injury, wound; to injure, to hurt

sentence.zh: 他在比赛中伤了腿，只好提前下场。
sentence.en: He hurt his leg during the match and had to leave the field early.

gloss: eye; measure word for wells, glances

sentence.zh: 她看了我一眼，什么也没说就走了。
sentence.en: She glanced at me and left without saying anything.

gloss: to order, to command; order, command

sentence.zh: 教练一声令下，队员们立刻冲了出去。
sentence.en: At the coach's command, the players dashed out at once.

gloss: to grab; to catch; to arrest

sentence.zh: 过马路的时候，孩子紧紧地抓着妈妈的手。
sentence.en: When crossing the road, the child held tightly onto his mother's hand.

gloss: strength, power, force; suffix for ability or force

sentence.zh: 他用力推开了那扇沉重的门。
sentence.en: He pushed open the heavy door with force.

gloss: to count; to be counted as (the most)

sentence.zh: 你数一数，一共来了多少人？
sentence.en: Count them: how many people came altogether?
